tools.name: read_selection
tools.description: Read currently selected cells. Returns 2D array + address.

tools.name: read_range
tools.description: Read any range from any sheet.

tools.name: extract_selection
tools.description: Extract the current selection (or a named range) to a NEW sheet. Trims whitespace, unifies Latin letter case, optionally dedupes. Handles tens of thousands of rows in Excel — do NOT read the whole column into the model and write_to_sheet it back. inspect/read_selection is not enough; this tool must run to finish.

sheetName.description: Optional. Source sheet. Default: current selection.

column.description: Optional. Header to extract, e.g. 店铺. Preferred over the current selection when the user named a column.

range.description: Optional. Source range e.g. G2:G27934. Default: current selection.

unique.description: If true, keep first occurrence only. Default false.

outputSheet.description: New sheet name. Default 列名_规范 or 列名_去重

tools.name: write_to_sheet
tools.description: Create a NEW sheet with data starting at A1. Do NOT use this to simulate reconciliation; use reconcile_tables.

tools.name: write_to_range
tools.description: Write values to a specific range in an existing sheet. For assumption cells in a live model, prefer write_inputs so formula cells are refused.

tools.name: write_inputs
tools.description: Change assumption/input cells only. Refuses any cell that already contains a formula so downstream recalculation stays intact. Use after inspect_formulas. Never send passwords here.

tools.name: find_replace
tools.description: Find/replace inside Excel (chunked). lookIn=values skips formula cells so live models stay intact. lookIn=formulas rewrites formula text. completeMatch replaces only whole-cell text. Do not read the sheet into the model to substitute strings.
